title: rpt problem record
description: One broken rule found by rpt validate or a checker plugin. Schema version 2.

path.description: File the problem is in, relative to the report root.

line.description: 1-based line; absent when the problem has no line.

column.description: 1-based byte offset in the line; only with line. rpt validate's rules don't set it; plugins may.

rule.description: The broken rule's name, public API. rpt validate's rules: readable, findingID, title, knownSeverity, scopeIDsExist, targets, requiredSections, evidence, config, scope, and the warnings textBeforeHeading, configUnknownKey and evidenceUnlinked. rpt assemble uses the same names for what it leaves out. Plugins may emit problems under rule names of their own.
